item.title: New author need greenlight for idea
item.description: I already wrote a draft but as a new author I have to get the idea greenlight first
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Elevator Pitch:
1. To classify a new SCP found from a meteorite in Arizona.
2. This SCP is a class Euclid anomaly. It can be potentially harmful to humans but benefit other SCPs.
3. Documents the new SCPs origin and potential tie into other foundation members.
4. Is a physical manifestation of anti-matter.
5. This document also serves as a warning to other foundation members for what dangers lie may occur if humans have extended contact with this entity.

Central Narrative:
Hikers keep disappearing in Sedona Arizona. The foundation finds it is due to an SCP that “hatched” out of a meteorite that crashed down to earth. This entity is intangible and dangerous to humans after extended exposure to it, causing them to “disappear”. It has a limited radius of its effect. This entity is a sentient black fog. It could be potentially useful to the foundation as it seems to interact with other SCPs in a positive way. It also needs to stay contained, as without proper measure, moves sporadically.

Hook/Attention Grabber:
This SCP is unique in the sense that though it is as of now classified as a Euclid entity, with the right research, could potentially become a Thaumiel entity if used to enhance the abilities of other SCPs the foundation finds useful. It also has the potential to be a tie into how anti-matter can affect other SCPs and may further help to understand all SCPs abilities. Not much is known about anti-matter today which is why I think it would be cool to have an entity made of it to enhance the aspect of mystery.

Additional Notes:
I already wrote a rough draft for the SCP article, but I am a new writer, so I must have the idea greenlight before the draft. My main concern is if there is another SCP like this as I have not read every article. I also want to make sure that I leave a lot of information a mystery without being overly vague.

item.title: Danger, SCP-999!
item.description: A failed attempt on SCP-999's life... but why? Why would something do that?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama, Emotional, Mystery

Elevator Pitch: Mysterious robotic entity found in Sweden. A group of cultists known as "The Children of the Scarlet King" trying to awaken it. The entity is eventually awoken, and easily contained, and has no real threat… until it meets SCP-999.

Central Narrative: The entity has no previous memories. Its memories slowly come back in small chunks. It meets SCP-999 and compulsively attacks it for a reason it does not understand. It claims that SCP-999 wanted to hurt it and was trying to defend itself (which is completely absurd). The missing information comes back to the entity in shattered pieces, however one factor is concrete, someone known as "The King".

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Children of the Scarlet King awakening an entity that attempts to kill SCP-999.

Additional Notes: This SCP will have many, MANY updates with cross tests, interviews, and containment breaches in the future.

SCP-999 will not perish in any future cross tests, containment breaches, etc.

item.title: SCP Idea: A Motel With An Elevator
item.description: A motel with an elevator? Weird, but It definitely just there for show, right...right?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article, exploration logs, incident logs, and interview logs.

Elevator Pitch: The SCP is an elevator behind a motel that can take you to 5 non-existents floors with doors that have weird stuff behind them

Genre: Horror and a little bit of comedy and emotion.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: In 2010, The manager of Moonlight Shores went to the back motel to have a quick smoke break. While he was smoking, he noticed an elevator near him. He never noticed there was an elevator because he would always smoke at the back of the motel, so he entered the elevator out of curiosity and saw that there are only six numbered buttons on the panel. He pressed on one of the buttons, and the elevator took him to a hallway full of rooms. He tried to open one of the doors but failed because it was locked. He tried using his management key to open it but failed again. As a last resort, he looked through the keyhole to see what was inside. He screamed and quickly ran back inside the elevator returning to our world. He then called the police and told them he saw a room that had eyeballs for walls and saw ordinary objects wrapped in human flesh. After investigation, the police contacted the Foundation, and then the Foundation purchased the property for testing.

D-personnel will be asked to open a few doors inside them and video-tape what they see or find along the way.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Each door has something special. One door could lead to a parallel-universe of earth, but it was taken over by an unknown species of animals. One door could lead you into a room that looks luxurious, but if you stay in there long enough. Its looks fade away and you're left with a room that looks abandoned. One door can be just a room filled with clown paintings, and those paintings can make the person that looks at them laugh to death (literally). Who knows!

(Not all the doors are gonna lead you into a room, some may lead you outside of the motel, but it's a different version of Earth. I know I said this, but I just wanted to let you guys know, so you won't get confused.)

Additional Notes: Since all the doors are locked. I was thinking about using SCP-005 to help open the doors. I know people don't like the idea of older SCP cross-linking to the newer ones, but I kinda like it (biased btw). If you guys don't like this cross-link, I will change it!

item.title: Idea for Greenlight - Russian Nesting Souls
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout (Optional): Standard layout + Incident/testing/interview logs

Elevator Pitch:
SCP-XXXX is a Russian nesting doll consisting of 3 layers. Upon opening the innermost doll; the object will activate. Upon activation, the 5 meter radius around the doll will be filled with a bright piercing light of no discernible origin for about 30 seconds. During this time, all individuals in area aside from the object's activator (henceforth SCP-XXXX-1) will immediately be vaporized. SCP-XXXX-1 will find themselves transfigured into one the now missing individuals, both in look and voice. The doll will now be embedded in the center of their chest with the front side protruding. Doll will now depict separate individual who was vaporized. Upon death or attempted removal of doll (which will cause instant heart failure), XXXX-1 will transfigure into individual depicted on doll, and the doll will change to depict a new individual. The entity will then come back to life. This process continues until all iterations have been cycled through and the entity will return to their original body; with the doll now depicting it's original marking. Any death or attempted removal after this point will result in permanent death at which object will dislodge itself. The object can speak telepathically to XXXX-1 and does so in a motherly Russian voice.

Central Narrative:
Through logs, the article will detail an incident during initial testing in which a D-class activated the object, resulting in the absorption of 2 researchers, an agent, a janitor, and another D-class. Further testing of object will be detailed as well as interviews with object will be noted. Ultimately, site directors decide object is safer contained in vessel as re-activation would require vessel be killed multiple times. Most knowledge of object is candidly provided by object itself in interviews. Object appears to have been created as a tool of war.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
I plan to weave a narrative of the D-class who has essentially became a living nesting doll, now with multiple "lives".

Additional Notes: I am aware of two other nesting doll SCP, so hopefully 3 isn't a crowd. The anomalous effects of the object should be fresh enough though.

item.title: SCP-5870
item.content:encoded:
Hello! Veralta's here with a new SCP about koalas, nature, the future of Australia, and intricate worldbuilding based on the beliefs of aboriginal Australian people like the Bundjalung and the Eora. Consider this SCP a free New Year trip through Australia, and a little bit of a crash course on the Australian condition.

Also, it's linked to Ralliston's Obearwatch Command; fun fact, all of these started when he threw the word "Koalalition" at me, and I said, "Hmm… uwah, this looks interesting". I initially planned out a short article with a gimmick and a punchline.

But then, I realized I had to dive deep into the waterhole.

The aboriginal Australian belief system, also called Dreamtime1, is very complex and interesting. It would be a shame if I just went with a silly punchline when aboriginal culture, with its mix of hopes and dreams for Australia, needs a chance to shine here.

Lastly, consider this article as a piece dedicated to Australians and wildlife - such as the koalas themselves - who have been affected by the severe bushfires. As a Filipino youth, I couldn't do much to be honest, aside from raising awareness. I tried to stay true to the myths' essence while adding my style of writing to them, while I researched news about the bushfires.

All in all, though, please enjoy this SCP, and I wish a Happy New Year - and more happy years - to come for all of us!

Special thanks to Ralliston2, Meisteroni, DrChandra, Rose the Changeling , for concept checking and making my narrative is solid. Dysadron and caspian2 also have my gratitude for their comprehensively good LBL and critique. Last but not the least, I also want to give a well-deserved shoutout to Dr Balthazaar for providing guidance on Australian beliefs and culture. You guys are amazing!

Footnotes
1. By the way, this word does not cover what the beliefs really mean, and while dreaming is a part of the culture, it is not just that. Additionally, the word "Dreamtime" may even be just a mistranslation of words meant for deities.
2. Bear goes rawr :p

item.title: Dark Dogs Ritual
item.description: A Dark Dog that is being summoned by a group of stray dogs and chases after them to feed.
item.content:encoded:
Greenlight: yes

Page layout: SCP article

Elevator pitch: Stray dogs goes into a forest to commence a ritual involving a black dog with the unidentifiable breed to have it fed. It only comes once three weeks; when that happens, the Dark dog will choose which dog to eat based on its bravery (fending off the creature). It will attack humans, will kill them but will not eat them.

+ Central Narrative
- Central Narrative

Central Narrative: Dr Fox observes them afore and tries to understand why these dogs are circling one particular spot, first time watching the dogs the research team had no idea about the three-week circle. So when the last day of the third week hits a giant dog appears and begins to chase the dogs around trying to find one that is stronger, all of the dogs dispersed its attacked spot where the researcher was and started to hunt them down. Dr Fox attempted to fend off the creature but was dragged under a car by three other dogs. Same with another researcher (they all hide) They hid under the car for 7 hours while the creature continues to hunt after dogs until it found one that began to bark at it, it ate the dog and disappeared back to the forest.

Later, Dr Fox wants to learn why one specific spot, so they dig the area and found skeletons of a man (named Damian) and a dog. Knowing this, they investigate the whole forest and learns that the bodies were murder victims. After extensive investigation, the lead points to his roommate. It said that Damian left his dorm to walk in the morning with his dog on 01/01/2014 and never returned. The roommate ends up being the one that killed Damian and the dog. While in containment, the stray dogs started to circle the site and caused containment breach, and the dark dog bites off Dr Fox’s hand (severely injuring her). And she learns that the dog and Damian’s skeletons when together were the ones that were manifesting the dark dog.

Hook/Attention: a little jab on the idea that dogs can sense evil spirits.

item.title: cartoon TV
item.description: A TV which creates cartoon logic and replace your brain pattern by a cartoon character.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article

SCP XXX is a cathode-ray tube TV which creates a field around it. In the field, everything is acting as if it exists in a cartoon. For example, you can´t fall down as long as you don´t look down.

The other anomalous property is that everyone observing a cartoon character in the TV has their brain pattern completely overlapped by the exactly cartoon character that was observed. For example, if you look at a cartoon dinosaur who is sentient, then you will believe you are a cartoon dinosaur.

Origin story: The object was recovered after a raid on the abandoned shopping mall of ████████, what seemed like a Chaos insurgency hideout, turned out to be a place to brainwash people with the help of the TV and a cartoon of chaos insurgency soldiers , into the believe that they are chaos insurgency soldier.

item.title: New SCiP: Just A Very Common Spectroscope (awaiting greenlights)
item.description: Which can turn also common light into deadly radiations
item.content:encoded:
Which can turn also common light into deadly radiations and then wreck the universe

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Sci-fi

Elevator Pitch: An optical widget which can mutate the wave length of electromagnetic waves it is exposed to nearby.

Central Narrative: Beyond some experiment logs, The real escalation starts shortly after the obtaining of the object by the Foundation. As the energy carried by light will magnify with the shortening of wave length, energy coming from nowhere accumulates in the universe and finally caused… deviation of balance of material and energy. Then unexpected results, like the worst - affect the gradual cosmic expansion or bring near the final collapse.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

  • What will happen if common, visible light around you turn into UV radiation, radioactive X- or even Gamma rays that will kill you in minutes?
  • We all seem indifferent to ectoentropic anomalies now since we've already had enough of them, but few have considered what consequential, long-term impact that "generating infinite water/favorite pizzas/inks/… from void" will do to a coherent universe. But they repaid now.

Additional Notes:

  • I'm not sure a spectroscope can work as the thing. Not having any expertise in optics, so I Googled and found an effect called "frequency doubling" similar to this. But as I know all these obeys the law of energy conservation (idk the actual mechanism). What better title can be applied other than "The Spectroscope" if so?
  • Not very sure how to merge the final world-threatening narrative into this ordinary object-describing document. Will a research report (regarding the status of the universe) or a test log work well?

Sincere thanks from an unexperienced writer! This idea has been around me for quite a while. After some nearly-failed trials of longer skips I wanna switch to an easier one…


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

item.title: Anomalous-D
item.description: Not your ordinary lab rat.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch

Anomalous-D (AD) is an extradimensional parasite which feeds on the pain, fear, grief or rage of other sentient entities. It became entangled with our reality and assumed human form eventually finding its way into a Foundation D Class assignment after being captured and convicted of a string of sadistic crimes against animals and people. Its position as a D Class brings it into frequent close proximity of various other anomalies. Anomalous D devises novel ways provoke or torture these anomalies undetected so that it can feed off their pain and rage.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative:

  • Containment procedure
  • Description of Entity
  • Description of how the creature came to be in containment / details of anomalous nature
  • Addenda:
    • Incident report: Containment breach first drawing scrutiny of AD
    • Memo: List of incident reports possibly involving AD
    • Interview: Log of the interview which reveals AD’s status as anomalous.
    • Interview: Log of feeding procedure
    • Memo: Detailing the variability of AD’s appearance
    • Memo: Possible reclassification as Keter / Thaumiel

Hook / Attention Grabber:

Following a major incident, the Foundation has confined it but is not sure that it is completely contained. Still, the possibility that this new anomaly may be used to injure or possibly destroy other anomalies is cannot be ignored.

Additional Notes:

Anomalous D typically resides between dimensions and might encounter various manifestations of other trans-dimensional creatures on its travels. It would not normally be able to feed on these entities as they would either be too powerful or impossible to hold on to. But in this reality it has found itself – quite accidentally – in a situation where the SCP foundation has trapped them and rendered them unable to defend themselves. Its motivation is to feed on their stress while not getting snared itself.

I expect that I’ll need lots of discussion and refinement to get this where I want it to be. This would be my first SCP contribution and I’m not an experienced writer. Additionally, most of what interests me in this concept are its possibilities for world-building and future story-telling. It will be challenging to bring this to life in a way that hooks the reader while also pointing to the other possibilities.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight - Self-Casting Spell
item.description: An article about the people made out of thaumaturgy, who are also kinda Polish. For more, see inside.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: A thaumaturgical sentient life-form, living deep in syberia, their culture with strong Polish influences left by Sybiraks. (Sybiraks were the Polish people resettled to Syberia.) It explores both the effects of Polish diaspora and the foundation containing a society.

Central Narrative: It starts off with the special containment procedures (the fenced off part of syberia), then there is a description (about how their bodies are made of what is basically sigils, about how they exchange spells that modify them as plasmids). Then it describes their culture, and the addeneum, where it is described how the sybiraks discover them and describe them, and offer them vodka and rabbit's blood, and how their societies get together, learning from each other and “forming a symbiosis”. It ends with the Incident, when they almost had a civil war.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The concept, I think. Also the ala genetics that arise inside them, and the weird stuff that arises cause of sentient beings being able to trade plasmids.

Additional Notes: Catholic sentient spells, which form tribes. An idea so weird, that it can work. Also their tribe is divided into three groups:
The Ultracatholics, lead by a Fanatical Pariah Priest, who want to make the other groups just as catholic.
The Tolerant, lead by the youngest of the elders, who want to cooperate with The Foundation, and to learn more of the outside world
The Traditionalists, lead by their shaman, who want to be freed and allowed to go back to the old Yakut ways.

item.title: Home is where I want to be
item.content:encoded:
Home, is where I want to be
But I guess I'm already there
I come home, she lifted up her wings
I guess that this must be the place


~David Byrne, "This Must Be the Place"

This tale is my attempt at emulating the style of Zyn's original Kiryu Labs series — probably one of the best early series on this site, propped up by Zyn's talent for writing heartwarming, touching stories with just the right balance between humour and heartfelt emotion. I hope I did Kiryu Labs justice with this.

Thanks to VoidLady, not_a_seagull, and Its a Bad Idea for helping me revise and edit this tale, and special thanks to Zyn for all that she does to help this community thrive. Have a wonderful New Year.

item.title: Dire Wolf
item.content:encoded:
This was my Art Exchange gift for Jacob Conwell, who asked for something that starred his character Sasha Merlo. I, however, hit a bit of a brick wall. Having read over a ton of Those Twisted Pines in preparation to write this character, I struggled because… she's finished! Her backstory is filled in by Kalinin, her frontstory is filled in by Jacob Conwell — and I mean, that covers her entire life. My first idea was to make a story centered around her husband, Gabe Merlo, but he's pretty developed as well, and has a boring job (no offense), so there wasn't much to do there either.

So I struggled a bit here, and then there, and bit my nails, was like oh no what do I do, until I realized that I had probably write a story about someone else in the canon while having Merlo be an important character in that story. As the tale evolved, Merlo's involvement went down until she had only two scenes (seen here), but… I couldn't figure out a better way to do it. So, Conwell, I'm sorry that this isn't precisely what you asked for, but I just fell in love with Phineas, and so here he is in all his glory.

Thanks for giving me such an interesting time. I've now read plenty more Twisted Pines than I'd ever read before, and my appreciation for your work has peaked. (Go check all your tales that feature Sasha Merlo. The majority of them have new comments by yours truly.)

There is more I want to say but it will have to wait until I have done some of my responsibilities for today.

item.description: Idea for a humanoid SCP that suffers from some form of mental illness with world-ending properties.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional, Tragedy

Page Type: This is my first SCP, the page layout/type will be simple with the standard containment and description with possible addendums.

Elevator Pitch: Although additional details may be added to the SCP, the core story being told is that this SCP is severely depressed and suicidal but is also theoretically capable of destroying the world via some form of anomalous powers that allows it to alter or change either the space-time continuum, quantum mechanics, or the foundations of existence, with more focus on the SCP's own mental health and how the Foundation can help the entity but obviously not in an altruistic way.

+ block
- Title for hiding text

Central Narrative: Containment procedures will first introduce the situation the SCP is in, introducing two Foundation Personnel that are sent by the ethics committee to be constant check-ups on the SCP, with the SCP being more beneficial being in home confinement accompanied by weekly therapy sessions. Footnotes and Addendums will include 'non-essential' information on the SCP.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The SCP is an extraordinarily powerful entity, quickly displaying its power to being able to stop a category-5 cyclone off the coast of Koror City, Palau before quickly dropping off the grid only to be found two days later on the island of Lesbos, Greece. Displaying a unique power that will slowly unveil itself through the course of the article as being able to change or alter a quintessential to the existence of creation, example if the entity so desired it could imagine the Foundation as to never existing or even go so far as to do it to all of existence yet do to the properties it would be classified as Keter if it weren't for the entity's own cooperation it has the classification of Safe as it has no desires to flee containment although refuses to leave its home to a more secure site.

Additional Notes: The focus of the article is less on the anomalous properties but more on how the Foundation interacts with an entity of uttermost world-ending power who suffers from depression and suicidal tendencies, showing the Foundation a more empathic side even if it isn't in an altruistic light.

item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) Joke SCP - mind-influencing game code
item.description: A seemingly insignificant script which mysteriously appears
item.content:encoded:
A seemingly insignificant script which mysteriously appears in popular online multiplayers, generates a user account of which in game exposure can influence the mind.

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Joke SCP

+ show block
– hide block

Elevator Pitch: The SCP would be a few lines of code, which would transfer itself from one online multiplayer game to another.

Once the script is embedded within its host, it becomes uneditable or deletable, generating a fictitious user account, referred to as SCP-XXXX-1 (however the script contains not enough code to emulate a user account, leaving foundation staff puzzled).

SCP-XXXX-1 is always generated with an identical username (making identifying affected games an easier task). SCP-XXXX-1 spends a majority of its time in its "inactive" state. However, during short periodic "active" states it performs in game tasks, including text or voice communication (important to monitor for potential interviews and testing).

Any player (in game) to interact or be exposed to SCP-XXXX-1 would start developing symptoms of online addiction, anti-social behaviours and dysphoria.

Central Narrative: This article will be written according to the standard layout. Starting with containment procedures, a description and finishing with an addendum.

containment procedures will outline only monetization instructions for the host game ( including a cover-up story for participating publishing companies to grant the SCP foundation moderation privileges in addition to the games code). Players coming into "contact" with SCP-XXXX-1 are automatically added to foundation listings for interviews and eventual administration of amnestics. Because of its shifting nature, it is considered "not contained". However, due to SCP-XXXX-1's docile and collaborative personality, it has been classed as Euclid.

The description will detail the SCP's nature, it's odd properties and theories. In addition to, SCP-XXXX-1's description, behavioural patterns and anomalous effects on players and how to recover from the latter. Finally, ending with the story of the SCP's discovery

The addendum will feature a list of games the SCP was previously part of.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This article seeks to create a fictitious origin for online additions to MMOs and becoming anti-social. In addition, this article is inspired by the collective input of the ChilloutVR community, by an inside joke/meme (hence "Joke SCP") of this very SCP joked to be the source of users who spend their lives in virtual reality (and by extension any other online multiplayers)

Additional Notes: I have a few concerns about copyright. Due to the nature of this article, it will rely heavily on existing games and companies to create the narrative. Am I allowed to use the names of existing companies?
